page.overview:
Who is Alyson Paij?

is the human captain of The Ill Hand and a pirate of the Revelry. She is a rival of Captain Avantika. As an NPC, Alyson is played by Matthew Mercer.

Alyson is a woman with curly, shoulder-length blonde hair and a scar over one eye that keeps the eye closed. She wears a tattered black coat.

Alyson is a fierce and abrasive woman whose demeanor makes Beauregard seem friendly. Enjoys a good brawl as much as she appreciates a stiff drink. Possesses an uncompromising sense of moral duty to the downtrodden.

Prior to the Mighty Nein meeting her, Alyson had been a rival to Avantika for some time. Avantika claims she had crossed paths with her multiple times, and that Alyson has previously embellished information to gain favor with the Plank King. While a pirate, she never raids civilian vessels and does her best to rein in the Revelry's cruelest captains and focus their efforts on those who deserve to have their goods stolen.
